description: This Java class 'HeaderValueValidator' implements a validator for checking if a given CharSequence is a valid representation of HeaderDefinition's Java types. It uses a chain of specific validators for different header value types and throws an exception if invalid. It is a deprecated singleton utility class.

classes.name: HeaderValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton final class that validates CharSequence representations against HeaderDefinition types using a chain of validators. It implements BiConsumer<HeaderDefinition, CharSequence>.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HeaderValueValidator.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Performs validation on the provided CharSequence according to the HeaderDefinition using a chain of validators. Throws an exception if validation fails.
